title: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence

policy_extraction.issuing_body: Executive Office of the President (White House)

evidence.quote: This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This EO primarily revokes EO 14110 and directs development of a new AI Action Plan within 180 days. It does not establish new safety requirements; rather, it removes prior safety-oriented directives. No safety requirements are imposed by this document. Enforcement is internal to executive branch agencies only.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is primarily framed around maintaining and enhancing American economic competitiveness and global AI dominance. The core justification for revoking prior AI governance is that existing policies act as 'barriers to American AI innovation.' The policy section explicitly names economic competitiveness alongside national security and human flourishing, but the operative logic throughout is about removing obstacles to U.S. global leadership.

evidence_spans.quote: To maintain this leadership, we must develop AI systems that are free from ideological bias or engineered social agendas.
It is the policy of the United States to sustain and enhance America's global AI dominance in order to promote human flourishing, economic competitiveness, and national security.

This order revokes certain existing AI policies and directives that act as barriers to American AI innovation, clearing a path for the United States to act decisively to retain global leadership in artificial intelligence.
